$comment: The one list of analytics events (DB-5, Q-P1-20). Edit here, then run `pnpm events:codegen`. A slice that starts emitting an event defines its props first; changing props after first emission bumps that event's version.

session_started.description: A visit began: the first request after 30 minutes without activity (Q-P1-21 return metric).

card_opened.description: A card was opened (Q-P1-21 "opened"). v2 adds the ids, to match opens to finishes (P1-W6-S04). v3 adds where it opened: Interval's in-app reader or the browser (ADR-0018).

section_finished.description: A moment's section was finished (Q-P1-21 "finished"). v2 adds the ids (P1-W6-S04).

article_finished.description: A whole-article card was finished. v2 adds the item id (P1-W6-S04).

note_saved.description: A note on a section or an article was written or edited (P2-W7-S03, Q-P2-01). Never the note's text.

quiz_started.description: A quiz started: Test 60s on a section or a whole article (P2-W9-S01, Q-P2-14), or a review session (P2-W9-S05, Q-P2-17). Version 2 adds kind; a review has no item.

quiz_answered.description: A quiz question was answered in time, first time only (P2-W9-S01). ms: from serving to answering.

quiz_finished.description: A Test 60s sprint was finished, once per attempt (P2-W9-S01).

question_flagged.description: A user flagged a question they answered, once per question (P2-W9-S07, Q-2, Q-P2-18). For the under-2% metric.

path_started.description: A user started (or resumed) a topic path, making it their active one (P2-W10-S03, Q-P2-27, Q-P2-28).

path_paused.description: A user's active path was paused: by them, or by their starting another (P2-W10-S05, Q-P2-23, Q-P2-28).

path_section_skipped.description: A user skipped a section of their path: no practiced credit, the next sections open (P2-W10-S05, Q-P2-23, Q-P2-28).

checkpoint_started.description: A checkpoint on a path section started, once per attempt (P2-W10-S04, Q-P2-26, Q-P2-28).

checkpoint_finished.description: A checkpoint was finished, once per attempt (P2-W10-S04, Q-P2-26, Q-P2-28). passed: it reached its pass mark (4 of 5; all but one of a smaller one).

item_saved.description: An item was saved (W4-S07; listed by the W5-S04 Library).

feedback_undone.description: Not interested undone right after it was given (W4-S07).

signup_completed.description: An account was made: by joining with an invite code (ADR-0016), or earlier by a guest signing up (S11, dormant).

guest_merged.description: A guest's activity was merged into an account (S12).

pwa_installed.description: The app was installed as a PWA (W5-S06).

outbound_click.description: A link to a publisher's page was followed.
